visualQualityCheckpoints.expected: Three-panel desktop app shell: persistent left sidebar, top filter bar, task tree content area, bottom status bar
Sidebar navigation groups are visually separated; task tree shows parent/child indentation; status and tags use color chips at leaf level

CSS variables from colors_and_type.css + Tailwind utilities; Lucide icons; inline tag colors for data identity
